meta.source: globals.css (shadcn/ui, Tailwind v4) written for Prod :D, October 2026

color.note: Three layers. Palette: the four block scales (500 is exact). Semantic: shadcn roles, neutral chrome. Product: brand-* variables each product sets. Themes are product x mode; Blue is a placeholder until Klick's colour is chosen.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page and app background. Neutral in every product.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text and icons on background, card and popover.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card and sheet surfaces. In dark mode cards sit a step lighter than the page so layers read without relying on borders alone.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts, dialogs and sheets. In dark mode a step lighter than cards, because they float above them.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Default buttons, switches and own chat bubbles. Black in light mode, inverts to near-white in dark.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Grey buttons, neutral badges, other people’s chat bubbles.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: segmented controls, skeletons, table headers, info banners. In dark mode lighter than cards so it still shows inside one.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, captions, metadata. AA on background and muted.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover fill for outline and ghost controls, menu highlight.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Outlines of interactive controls: text fields, checkboxes, radios, the switch track when off, outline buttons, the chat composer. 3:1 against the background in both modes, so a field is always findable. Decorative lines use border instead.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring. At least 3:1 against the background in both modes (3.1 light, 4.2 dark).

tokens.name: switch-thumb
tokens.usage: The switch thumb when off. Light in both modes so an off switch stays visible on a dark track. When on, the thumb uses primary-foreground.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete, block, remove, failed sends and field errors. Off the brand hues on purpose.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a solid destructive fill.

tokens.name: destructive-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted surface for destructive banners and badges; text on it uses destructive.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Sent, saved, accepted, connected. Off the brand hues on purpose.

tokens.name: success-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a solid success fill.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted surface for success banners and badges; text on it uses success.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Expiring access, overdue follow-ups. Always pair with an icon: it sits near the yellow and red blocks. Off the brand hues on purpose.

tokens.name: warning-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a solid warning fill.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted surface for warning banners and badges; text on it uses warning.

tokens.name: privacy
tokens.usage: Who can see this: Only you, Mutual, Event-visible, Revoked. Never used for anything else. Violet so it can never be mistaken for a product colour.

tokens.name: privacy-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a solid privacy fill.

tokens.name: privacy-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted surface for privacy banners and badges; text on it uses privacy.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info banners use neutral ink plus an info icon, because blue is a product colour.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info banner surface.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The product’s block colour at full value, for pure colour with nothing set over it: the block and studs, highlights, progress bars, selection, the avatar ring. Brand surfaces that carry words or icons (buttons, badges, the date tab, the QR button) use brand-fill instead. Never page backgrounds or body copy.

tokens.name: brand-fill
tokens.usage: The brand fill behind text and icons: brand buttons, solid badges, the event date tab, the QR button, brand panels. Red and blue use their 700 so white text passes AA (5.7:1 and 6.8:1); yellow and green are the block colour itself with black text. Always pair with brand-foreground.

tokens.name: brand-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-fill. White on red and blue (5.7:1 and 6.8:1 on their 700), near-black on yellow and green (14.3:1 and 8.1:1). Every pairing passes AA.

tokens.name: brand-on-large
tokens.usage: Large text set straight on the bright block colour (brand), such as a marketing headline or a label on an illustration. Near-black in every product: 5.9:1 on red, 4.6:1 on blue, 14.3:1 on yellow, 8.1:1 on green. For white text on a brand surface, use brand-fill with brand-foreground.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: A darker brand fill for places that need white small text, such as a status chip or a dense toolbar. Red and blue 700, green 800; yellow stays 500 because its deeper steps turn brown.

tokens.name: brand-strong-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-strong. White for red, blue and green (all above 5.5:1); near-black for yellow.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted brand surface: event headers, why-this-match panels, selected rows, product chips.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured text and links. Passes AA on background and brand-soft in every product. Not for text on a brand fill.

tokens.name: brand-border
tokens.usage: Outline on brand-soft surfaces and brand avatars.

tokens.name: brand-edge
tokens.usage: The edge and stud shadow on the product block (Block, KlickSuccess, the app mark). Not used on buttons or other UI.

families.sans: "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: onboarding, Klick success, empty states. Steps up to display-lg from bp-lg.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles, event and person headers. Steps up to title-lg from bp-lg.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Replaces display from bp-lg. Phones and tablets keep display (40px).

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Replaces title from bp-lg. Every other style stays the same size on all screens.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: You both want to meet early-stage founders.
styles.usage: Default reading text, notes, messages. Text typed into inputs is 16px on phones so iOS does not zoom the page.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: From Google Calendar, synced 2 hours ago

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap in badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and inline controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field padding, gap inside rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups on a screen.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero and empty-state breathing room.

radius.note: From --radius: 0.75rem. Moulded plastic: soft corners, never sharp, never blobby.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, inline code, tiny chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small buttons, segmented-control thumbs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, alerts. The default.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, toasts, large buttons.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Sheets, the chat composer, the Klick success panel, bottom nav.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, pills, avatars, switches.

shadow.note: Flat UI: buttons and surfaces carry no edge or lift. The only soft shadows are for things that float (toasts, menus, dialogs) and the switch thumb. The block edge lives only on the product block.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Toasts, popovers, menus. The only soft shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: The switch thumb, so it reads against the track.

breakpoint.note: Tailwind's defaults, so sm:, md:, lg: and xl: utilities match. Design mobile first: the base styles are the phone, each breakpoint adds.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones in landscape, small tablets. Rarely needs its own layout.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablets. Bottom nav gives way to the sidebar rail; card lists become two columns; sheets become centred dialogs.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Laptops. The full sidebar with labels appears; display and title step up to display-lg and title-lg.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Desktops. Card grids go to three columns; content stops widening at content-wide.

layout.note: Page widths, gutters and fixed chrome sizes. Content is fluid between them.

tokens.name: gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Side padding on phones, below bp-md.

tokens.name: gutter-tablet
tokens.usage: Side padding from bp-md.

tokens.name: gutter-desktop
tokens.usage: Side padding from bp-lg.

tokens.name: content-narrow
tokens.usage: Max width for reading and single-column flows: onboarding, settings, a memory, chat.

tokens.name: content-wide
tokens.usage: Max width for card grids and Home on large screens.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Full sidebar with labels, from bp-lg.

tokens.name: sidebar-rail
tokens.usage: Icon-only sidebar rail, from bp-md to bp-lg.

tokens.name: bottom-nav-height
tokens.usage: Bottom nav height before the safe-area inset is added. Pad scrolling content by this plus env(safe-area-inset-bottom).

tokens.name: dialog-width
tokens.usage: Centred dialog width from bp-md. Below that the same content is a bottom sheet.

tokens.name: sheet-max-height
tokens.usage: Tallest a bottom sheet may grow on phones before it scrolls inside.

size.note: Control and icon sizes. Touch screens get 44px controls: Apple's minimum touch target.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and inline controls with a pointer. On touch, small buttons grow to 36px and keep a 44px hit area.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Default button and input height with a mouse or trackpad.

tokens.name: control-touch
tokens.usage: Default button and input height on touch screens (pointer: coarse).

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons: full-width primary actions on phones, the bottom of sheets.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum tappable area on touch, even when the visible control is smaller (switches, small buttons, icon buttons).

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons, badges and text.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icons in list rows and settings.

tokens.name: icon-nav
tokens.usage: Navigation icons in the bottom nav and sidebar.

tokens.name: avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Avatars in dense rows and chat headers.

tokens.name: avatar
tokens.usage: Default avatar in cards and lists.

tokens.name: avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Profile headers and the incoming request screen.
